scope: R-008 candidate D first trial: full OEM stack retained, gate on DisplayDxe StartImage success
key_finding_no_stall: with all 33 OEM drivers in the image the firmware still completed and reset on its own. Nothing in the vendor stack hangs on enuma, so candidate D does not repeat the earlier bus-hang failure mode.

screen_observation.before_boot: frames 0-6 mean grey about 130, the Android launcher is visible
screen_observation.from_fastboot_onward: frames 7-13 mean grey about 56 and the panel reads as a mirror, i.e. backlight off
screen_observation.contrast: entering fastboot manually at 17:44 showed an orange FASTBOOT wordmark; during this trial's fastboot window and throughout the firmware run nothing was drawn
screen_observation.meaning: DisplayDxe did not light the panel in this trial

timing_reading.hypothesis: roughly 8 s of extra dispatch cost for 33 OEM drivers plus the 7 s completion fallback, which fits a DisplayDxe that returned an error rather than the success gate firing (success would have reset 2 s after DisplayDxe)
timing_reading.status: estimate only; 33 drivers versus a handful makes the extra dispatch cost unknown, so this does not decide the case

discriminating_test: run the same profile with detail point 16 (DisplayDxe StartImage failure). If the two gates differ in return time in the predicted direction, the vendor driver's status is settled: fast on 16 means it returns an error, slow on 16 means it returns success and the 17 run was the fast path.
interpretation: 原厂33驱动栈在enuma上能跑完并自动返回,不再出现挂死;但显示未被点亮,DisplayDxe大概率返回错误(时间估算支持但未定)。下一步用detail16失败门对照判定其返回状态。
